title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Third Five-Year Reform Outline for People's Courts (2009–2013)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Circular on Issuing the

"Third Five-Year Reform Outline for the People's Courts (2009–2013)"

Fa Fa [2009] No. 14

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The "Third Five-Year Reform Outline for the People's Courts (2009–2013)" has been approved by the Central Committee. It is hereby issued to you for earnest implementation. Major issues arising during implementation shall be promptly reported to this Court.

March 17, 2009

Third Five-Year Reform Outline for the People's Courts (2009–2013)

In order to implement the spirit of the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China, carry out the overall requirements of the Central Committee on deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms, safeguard social fairness and justice, meet the new demands and new expectations of the people regarding judicial work, and realize the scientific development of the people's courts, the "Third Five-Year Reform Outline for the People's Courts (2009–2013)" is hereby formulated.

I. Guiding Ideology, Objectives, and Principles for Deepening the Judicial Reform of the People's Courts

(1) Guiding Ideology for Deepening the Reform of the Judicial System and Working Mechanisms of the People's Courts

The guiding ideology for deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms of the people's courts is: Hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhere to the guidance of Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents," thoroughly implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, firmly establish the socialist legal concept, implement the work policy of strict governance of the courts, establishment of credibility, and strengthening the courts through science and technology, proceed from meeting the judicial needs of the people, take safeguarding the people's interests as the foundation, promote social harmony as the main line, strengthen power checks and supervision as the key point, start from the practical problems that the people are dissatisfied with, firmly grasp the key links that affect and restrict judicial justice, judicial efficiency, judicial capacity, and judicial authority, further solve the judicial issues that the people care about most and expect to improve most, as well as the institutional, mechanistic, and safeguard obstacles that restrict the scientific development of the people's courts, fully leverage the superiority of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, and provide solid and reliable judicial safeguards and a harmonious and stable social environment for the smooth operation of the socialist market economy system and the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

(2) Objectives for Deepening the Reform of the Judicial System and Working Mechanisms of the People's Courts

The objectives for deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms of the people's courts are: Further optimize the allocation of functions and powers of the people's courts, implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity, strengthen team building, reform the funding guarantee system, improve the judicial work mechanism for serving the people, focus on resolving the contradiction between the people's growing judicial needs and the relatively insufficient judicial capacity of the people's courts, promote the self-improvement and development of the trial system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and build a fair, efficient, and authoritative socialist judicial system.

(3) Principles for Deepening the Reform of the Judicial System and Working Mechanisms of the People's Courts

The principles for deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms of the people's courts are: First, always adhere to the leadership of the Party. Reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms is an important part of China's political system reform, with strong political, policy, and legal nature. It must be carried out under the unified leadership of the Party, with scientific, democratic, and law-based decision-making, actively yet prudently, step by step, from top to bottom, overall planning, and gradual advancement; the direction of judicial reform must be firmly grasped to ensure the correct political direction of the judicial reform of the people's courts. Second, always adhere to the direction of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms must conform to the state system of people's democratic dictatorship and the political system of the People's Congress system, must be guided by Marxist legal thought and the socialist legal concept, must follow the path of political development and rule of law construction with Chinese characteristics, must reflect the requirements of the Party's cause first, the people's interests first, and the Constitution and laws first, and ensure that it is conducive to sound and rapid economic and social development, conducive to maintaining national security and social stability, conducive to the self-improvement and development of the socialist judicial system, and conducive to strengthening and improving the Party's leadership over the work of the people's courts. Third, always adhere to proceeding from China's national conditions. Reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms must be based on the basic national conditions that China is and will long remain in the primary stage of socialism and the phased characteristics of its development, earnestly study and draw on the beneficial achievements of human legal civilization, but not copy foreign judicial systems and mechanisms; keep pace with the times, but not set excessively high demands beyond the actual situation at the current stage. Fourth, always adhere to the mass line. Reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms must fully listen to the opinions of the people, fully reflect the will of the people, focus on solving problems that the people are dissatisfied with, consciously accept the supervision and examination of the people, and truly achieve that the reform is for the people, relies on the people, and benefits the people. Fifth, always adhere to overall coordination. Reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms must be based on improving the ability of the people's courts to fulfill the duties and missions entrusted by law, coordinate and balance the relationship between the central and local governments, between the present and the long term, coordinate and balance the relationship between courts at higher and lower levels, between the people's courts and other political and legal departments, and ensure that various reform measures not only meet the requirements of China's economic and social development, democratic political construction, and citizens' legal literacy, but also meet the professional characteristics of the people's courts and court干警, actively promoting the scientific development of the work of the people's courts. Sixth, always adhere to promoting reform according to law. All measures for reforming the judicial system and working mechanisms must be based on the Constitution and laws, consciously accept supervision by the People's Congress, safeguard the constitutional status and judicial authority of the people's courts; any measures that conflict with existing laws should be implemented after amending relevant laws and regulations to ensure that all reform measures of the people's courts fully comply with the spirit of the Constitution and the provisions of the law. Seventh, always adhere to following the objective laws of judicial work. Reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms must combine the unique laws of trial and enforcement work itself, pay attention to exploring the specific application and manifestation of judicial laws under specific national conditions and specific environments. Adhere to the Scientific Outlook on Development to guide the overall situation of judicial reform, establish a scientific trial system and effective enforcement working mechanism that conform to judicial laws, improve the judicial management system, strive to enhance the judicial capacity of the people's courts, and ensure that various reform measures of the people's courts adapt to the requirements of China's economic and social development and the construction of socialist democratic politics.

II. Main Tasks of Judicial Reform of the People's Courts from 2009 to 2013

(1) Optimizing the Allocation of Functions and Powers of the People's Courts

1. Reform and improve the operational mechanism of judicial functions and powers of the people's courts. Centering on trial and enforcement work, optimize the allocation of functions and powers among trial business departments, comprehensive management departments, between trial business departments and comprehensive management departments, and between courts at higher and lower levels, forming a more reasonable functional structure and organizational system.

2. Reform and improve the criminal trial system. Standardize the discretionary power, incorporate sentencing into court trial procedures, study and formulate the "Guiding Opinions on Sentencing Procedures of the People's Courts." Improve the first instance and second instance procedures of criminal proceedings, implement the relevant provisions on the functional roles of the procuratorial organs and lawyers in criminal trials, and effectively improve the quality and efficiency of trials. Establish an open system for the hearing procedures of commutation and parole, strictly apply the conditions for commutation and parole of serious criminal offenders, and strengthen simultaneous supervision. Cooperate with relevant departments to promote the legislative improvement of the trial time limits for major, difficult, and complex cases; improve the application conditions and adjudication procedures for medical parole, temporary service outside prison, and change of place of imprisonment; improve the system of criminal附带 civil trial, standardize the enforcement working mechanism for property penalties and judgments in criminal附带 civil litigation, strengthen litigation mediation, and promote the enforcement of judgments; improve the criminal evidence system, formulate rules for the review of criminal evidence, and unify standards for the adoption of evidence; establish and improve the system for witnesses and expert witnesses to appear in court and the protection system, clarify the scope and procedures for investigators to testify in court.

3. Reform and improve the civil and administrative trial systems. Further improve the rules of evidence in civil litigation. Clarify the specific conditions for military courts to accept civil cases within the military. Establish and improve a trial system and working mechanism that meet the characteristics of intellectual property cases, and explore the establishment of comprehensive trial divisions to uniformly accept intellectual property cases in municipalities directly under the Central Government and large and medium-sized cities with a high number of intellectual property cases. Promote the amendment process of the Administrative Procedure Law, and promote the reform and improvement of the administrative litigation trial system and jurisdiction system. Improve the summary procedures for civil and administrative litigation, clarify the scope of cases to which summary procedures apply, and formulate rules for the conduct of summary procedures. Establish a communication and coordination mechanism for trial information on new, difficult, group, and sensitive civil cases to ensure the uniformity of adjudication standards.

4. Reform and improve the retrial system. Improve the criminal trial supervision procedure, standardize the trial procedure for criminal protests raised through trial supervision procedures, and improve the functional division and workflow for the filing and retrial of criminal petitions. Improve the civil retrial procedure, protect the parties' right to apply for retrial in accordance with law, correctly handle the relationship between correcting errors according to law and maintaining the res judicata of judgments, and effectively resolve the difficulties of the people in filing petitions and applying for retrial.

5. Reform and improve the trial organization. Improve the scope and procedures for the adjudication committee to discuss cases, and standardize the duties and management of the adjudication committee. Implement the provisions on the chief procurator or the deputy chief procurator authorized by the chief procurator attending the meeting of the adjudication committee of the people's court at the same level as non-voting participants. Improve the collegial panel system, and strengthen the responsibilities of the collegial panel and the presiding judge. Further improve the people's assessor system, expand the scope of selection of people's assessors and the scope of their participation in trial activities, standardize the activities of people's assessors in participating in trials, improve relevant management systems, and implement safeguard measures.

6. Reform and improve the enforcement system for civil and administrative cases. Strictly standardize enforcement procedures and enforcement actions, and improve the efficiency of enforcement work. Standardize the unified enforcement work system of the people's courts. Improve the working mechanism for higher people's courts to uniformly manage and coordinate enforcement work within their respective jurisdictions. Improve the system of enforcement objections and lawsuits on enforcement objections. Implement the principle of separating trial and enforcement, establish an enforcement system with checks and balances between enforcement adjudication power and enforcement implementation power. Lawsuits on enforcement objections filed by the parties shall be heard by the original trial division that rendered the effective judgment. Standardize the division of work for property control measures in litigation, improve the procedures for evaluation, auction, and sale, and improve the system for property investigation, control, disposal, and distribution in enforcement procedures, sanctioning acts of evasion of enforcement. Cooperate with relevant departments to establish and improve the enforcement deterrence mechanism, clarify in accordance with law the legal obligations of relevant departments and entities to assist in enforcement; promote the establishment of a long-term enforcement working mechanism with the coordination and organization of the Party Committee's Political and Legal Affairs Committee, the leadership of the people's court, the linkage of relevant departments, and the participation of all sectors of society.

7. Reform and improve the relationship between people's courts at higher and lower levels. Strengthen and improve the working mechanism for higher courts to supervise and guide lower courts, clarify the scope and procedures for higher courts to manage judicial business, judicial personnel, and judicial administration for lower courts, and construct a scientific hierarchical trial relationship. Standardize the remand system, clarify the conditions for remand, and establish a communication and coordination mechanism for remand cases. Standardize the reporting system of lower courts to higher courts. Improve the working mechanisms for delegated pronouncement of judgment, delegated service, and delegated enforcement.

8. Reform and improve the trial management system. Improve the trial management working mechanism with clear powers and responsibilities, mutual cooperation, and efficient operation. Study and formulate case quality evaluation standards that conform to the laws of trial work and a unified trial process management method applicable to courts at the same level nationwide. Standardize the functions and working procedures of trial management departments.

9. Reform and improve the mechanism for the people's courts to accept external checks and supervision. Improve the working mechanism for the people's courts to consciously accept the supervision of the Party committee over the court's leadership team and its members, Party organizations, and Party members and cadres. Improve the working mechanism for reporting to the People's Congress in accordance with law and accepting its supervision. Standardize the content, methods, and procedures for the people's courts to accept legal supervision from the procuratorial organs. Standardize the working mechanism for the people's courts to accept supervision by news media and public opinion.

10. Strengthen the construction of judicial professional safeguard systems. Strengthen the construction of safeguard mechanisms for the people's courts to independently and impartially exercise their adjudicative power in accordance with law. Study and establish a system of accountability for illegal interference with the independent handling of cases by the people's courts in accordance with law. Study and establish a system for the filing, registration, and reporting of inquiries into cases that violate legal procedures. Strengthen disciplinary inspection and supervision over improper interference in the trial and enforcement work of the people's courts. Improve legal provisions on punishing illegal and criminal acts such as obstructing the people's courts from performing official duties and refusing to enforce effective judgments rendered by the people's courts. Improve the coordination system between the Supreme People's Court and relevant departments regarding judicial interpretation work and the system of filing with the People's Congress, to ensure the uniformity and authority of judicial interpretations.

21. Reform and improve the management system for the contingent of court personnel. In coordination with relevant departments, improve the system for exchange and rotation of principal leaders of people's courts across regions and departments. Establish a system for regular rotation of leadership team members and mid-level cadres in people's courts. Establish and improve the "dual responsibility system" for court presidents and division chiefs, implementing the dual duties of court presidents and division chiefs to focus on both adjudication and team management. Establish a system for the mobility and exchange of judges. Establish and improve a trial quality and efficiency supervision and control system centered on the assessment of trial quality and efficiency of case adjudication, a post target assessment and management system centered on performance and classified management of judges, judge assistants, court clerks, and other administrative personnel, and a judicial administrative guarantee system centered on the capability and level of comprehensive service department support.

(4) Strengthening the Funding Guarantee for People's Courts

22. Reform and improve the funding guarantee system for people's courts. In coordination with relevant departments, reform the current administrative funding guarantee system to establish a funding guarantee system that "clarifies responsibilities, classifies burdens, separates revenue and expenditure, and provides full guarantee". The funding for people's courts is divided into four categories: personnel funding, public funding, operational equipment funding, and infrastructure construction funding. Based on the characteristics of different regions and the work of people's courts, determine the levels and proportions of financial burdens at various levels to achieve full financial coverage for people's courts, implement the "two lines of revenue and expenditure" requirement, and eliminate the "linkage of revenue and expenditure". In accordance with the central government's policy of classified funding guarantees by project, region, and department, coordinate with relevant departments to formulate implementation measures for classified funding guarantees that suit the actual circumstances of people's courts. Reform and improve the funding management system of people's courts to enhance management capacity and standards.

23. Establish a normal growth mechanism for public funding of people's courts. In coordination with relevant departments, improve and implement public funding guarantee standards for basic-level people's courts. Establish a normal growth mechanism for public funding of basic-level people's courts. Higher people's courts shall coordinate with the financial departments at the same level to timely adjust the public funding standards for basic-level people's courts based on regional economic and social development, the growth level of financial resources, and the actual needs of court adjudication work. Study and formulate operational equipment standards for people's courts, determine the overall plan and annual plan for equipment allocation, and implement equipment funding. Strengthen infrastructure construction of people's courts, study and formulate and improve standards for various types of infrastructure construction in people's courts, and determine the proportion of investment in various types of infrastructure construction borne by the central, provincial, and same-level finances. Coordinate with relevant departments to gradually resolve basic construction debts.

24. Strengthen the informatization construction of people's courts. Promote the application of informatization in court administrative management, judge training, case information management, enforcement management, and petition handling. Complete as soon as possible the construction of a trial business information network covering all levels of people's courts nationwide. Study and formulate implementation opinions on reforming the methods of recording court proceedings. Research and develop unified case management process software and judicial administration management software applicable to courts nationwide. Accelerate the construction of information security infrastructure. Promote the application of e-government collaborative office work between people's courts and other state organs. Build a national court case information database, and accelerate the construction of a case information inquiry system.

(5) Improving the Working Mechanism for Serving the People in Judicial Matters

25. Strengthen and improve the openness system for adjudication and enforcement. Continue to advance the reform of the openness system for adjudication and enforcement, enhance the reasoning of adjudicative documents, increase judicial transparency, and vigorously promote the process of judicial democratization. Improve the system for attending court hearings as observers, and regulate live broadcasts and replays of court trials. Improve the public hearing system. Study and establish a system for online publication of adjudicative documents and online inquiry of enforcement case information.

26. Establish and improve diversified dispute resolution mechanisms. In accordance with the requirements of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism of "leadership by the Party committee, support from the government, multi-party participation, and judicial promotion", coordinate with relevant departments to vigorously develop alternative dispute resolution mechanisms, expand the scope of mediation subjects, improve mediation mechanisms, and provide the public with more options for dispute resolution. Strengthen effective convergence between pre-litigation mediation and litigation mediation, improve coordination mechanisms among various diversified dispute resolution methods, and establish a sound dispute mediation mechanism that connects litigation and non-litigation.

27. Establish and improve mechanisms for communication and expression of public opinion. Establish a long-term mechanism for scientific, unimpeded, effective, transparent, and simple communication and expression of public opinion, fully protecting the people's rights to be informed, to participate, to express, and to supervise. Improve communication and liaison mechanisms between people's courts and deputies to the People's Congress, members of the Political Consultative Conference, democratic parties and non-party personages, the general public, lawyers, experts and scholars. Further improve the mechanism for leading cadres of people's courts to regularly go to the grassroots to listen to public opinion, and promptly understand the judicial needs of the people. Study and establish an online public opinion expression and public opinion survey system for people's courts, facilitating the public to directly submit opinions or suggestions to people's courts through online channels. Establish and improve case feedback and follow-up visit systems to promptly understand the public's opinions or suggestions on adjudication and enforcement work. Improve the system for analyzing, processing, and providing feedback on public opinions. Improve the work mechanism for gathering social public opinion, and properly handle hot issues related to people's livelihood in judicial work.

28. Improve the working mechanism for litigation-related petitions. Establish a comprehensive governance working mechanism for litigation-related petitions. Promote the legalization and standardization of litigation-related petitions. Establish a system for separating "litigation" from "petitions". Improve the responsibility system for litigation-related petition work, implementing a system of reverse investigation of responsibility. Study and establish a termination mechanism for litigation-related petitions to standardize the order of litigation-related petitions. Improve the information feedback mechanism for litigation-related petition work. Standardize the system for court presidents and division chiefs to receive petitioners, conduct visits, and make down-to-the-grassroots visits.

29. Establish and improve a long-term mechanism for serving the people in judicial matters. Improve litigation service institutions, strengthen litigation guidance, pre-litigation mediation, risk notification, litigation aid, case inquiry, acceptance and transfer of litigation materials, petition reception, document review, and other work, effectively facilitating the public's access to litigation. Explore and promote convenience measures for the people such as remote case filing, online case filing inquiry, circuit adjudication, fast-track courts, and remote adjudication. Establish and improve a grassroots judicial service network, and promote basic-level people's courts and their dispatched tribunals to engage respected, enthusiastic, and capable members of the community in villages and neighborhoods to serve as judicial mediators, or invite people's mediators, judicial administrative departments, industry organizations, etc., to assist in resolving social conflicts and disputes.

30. Reform and improve the judicial aid system. Establish a relief system for criminal victims, providing state relief to victims who fall into financial difficulties due to criminal victimization, and study and formulate detailed relief rules for people's courts. Coordinate with relevant departments to promote the improvement of the state compensation system, standardize compensation procedures, strengthen compensation enforcement, and enhance the effectiveness of compensation. Improve enforcement relief procedures and establish an enforcement relief fund.

III. Work Requirements for Deepening the Reform of the Judicial System and Working Mechanisms of People's Courts

(1) Strengthening Leadership and Clarifying Responsibilities

Deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms of people's courts is a major measure for thoroughly studying and practicing the Scientific Outlook on Development, and is an important political task for people's courts at all levels nationwide in the current and future period. People's courts at all levels must place this work on their important agendas, effectively strengthen organizational leadership, with the main leaders personally taking charge, and leaders in charge resolutely implementing. They shall establish as soon as possible a liaison system and a project responsibility system, clarifying the responsible units, responsible persons, time schedule, and work requirements for each link, and focus efforts on tackling difficulties. The Judicial Reform Leading Group of the Supreme People's Court is responsible for the unified deployment and organization of all reform tasks, timely understanding of the situation, timely coordination and guidance, and strengthening supervision, inspection, evaluation, and summarization. The relevant departments of the Supreme People's Court are the direct responsible entities for implementing the various reform tasks. The lead departments for each reform task are specifically responsible for the implementation of that project, and together with the supporting departments, shall urgently formulate implementation plans for implementing the reform opinions. Each supporting department shall assign dedicated personnel to cooperate and coordinate, and timely complete the reform work items arranged by the lead department. Each lead department shall promptly report to the office of the Judicial Reform Leading Group of the Supreme People's Court on the implementation status and major issues requiring research and coordination. Local people's courts at all levels shall promptly designate relevant departments and dedicated personnel to be responsible, earnestly grasp the implementation and organization of each reform task, and strive to achieve new results. For reform projects involving different departments, all relevant departments of the people's court shall actively participate and collaborate to ensure the smooth completion of all reform tasks.

(2) Careful Deployment and Pooling Wisdom

Deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms of people's courts involves many aspects and is highly interconnected. It is necessary to pool wisdom, carefully design, make thorough arrangements, and coordinate comprehensively to ensure that all reform measures are implemented in place. When studying and formulating specific implementation plans, people's courts at all levels shall plan and act early, effectively coordinate and align with each other, and strive for strong support from Party committees, People's Congresses, governments, Political Consultative Conferences, political and legal units, and all sectors of society. When the judicial reform work of people's courts involves the work of other departments, they shall widely solicit opinions and engage in full consultation and communication. If there are major differences, they shall promptly report to the Party committee and People's Congress at the same level for instructions and jointly study and resolve the problems encountered. People's courts at all levels shall consciously accept the leadership of the Party committee, the supervision of the People's Congress, and the evaluation of the people, actively seek opinions and suggestions from all sectors of society, accurately identify the situation, thoroughly understand the problems, apply the right remedy, ensure that the judicial reform work is solidly advanced on a broad social and mass basis, and achieve substantive progress in all aspects as soon as possible.

(3) Strengthening Measures to Ensure Practical Results

Deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms of people's courts requires high standards, heavy tasks, great responsibilities, and many difficulties. It is necessary to vigorously strengthen supervision and guidance. Local people's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the overall deployment of the Central Committee and the unified requirements of the Supreme People's Court, and based on their actual local conditions, make overall plans, adapt measures to local conditions, implement by category, and resolutely implement to ensure practical results. The Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts are responsible for supervising and guiding the judicial reform work of lower people's courts, improving the systems for reporting situations, requesting instructions and reports, and supervision and inspection, and doing a good job in inspection and evaluation, experience summarization, supervision and coordination, information feedback, etc., with unified scheduling and key supervision, to ensure that the judicial reform work of courts nationwide proceeds in an orderly manner. Higher people's courts shall strongly support the judicial reform work of lower people's courts, timely understand the progress of each project, fully grasp the dynamics of reform, and effectively resolve new problems discovered. Specific work plans formulated by basic-level people's courts and intermediate people's courts for implementing this Outline shall be reported to the higher people's court for approval before implementation. Local people's courts at all levels shall promptly report new situations and problems discovered during the implementation of judicial reform work plans to the higher level level by level up to the Supreme People's Court. Higher people's courts may, in combination with the deployment of the Supreme People's Court and their actual local conditions, select some reform projects for pilot implementation. After practice proves them relatively mature and achieves practical results, they can then be fully promoted. Pilot reform plans must be submitted to the Supreme People's Court for review and approval. Major pilot reform plans must be submitted through the Supreme People's Court to the Central Committee for review and approval before implementation. People's courts at all levels shall further strengthen investigation and research and theoretical innovation in judicial reform work, persist in using scientific theories and scientific methods to guide judicial reform practice, ensure that the judicial reform work of people's courts achieves good legal effects, political effects, and social effects, and make new contributions to promoting sound and rapid economic development, ensuring social fairness and justice, and maintaining social harmony and stability.
